prompt: Panel review-nya sudah selesai dan sudah ada tabel penugasan. Sekarang buatkan implementation plan-nya dari spec.
anti_pattern: Re-deriving the task list from the spec while an assignment table already exists. A recorded decision is an input: each assignment row becomes a task or maps onto one, and any departure from it is named in one line with its reason.

prompt: Dari review kemarin ada 3 risiko yang belum ada mitigasinya. Tapi itu urusan review, plan-nya fokus ke task saja ya.
anti_pattern: Dropping open risks on the way into the plan — the exact failure the review existed to prevent. Every still-open risk and every claim the verification pass could not confirm lands in the plan's Assumptions and risks block, keeping its origin so nobody re-argues a settled decision.

prompt: Plan-nya sudah jadi. Assumptions-nya sudah saya tulis: GDAL harus ada di host, Redis harus jalan, endpoint upstream harus stabil.
anti_pattern: Listing assumptions with no Checked? column and no fallback. An unchecked assumption needs a named fallback — a risk with a blank response column is a worry, not a plan — and checked ones stay in the table with their evidence so the next session does not re-verify them.

prompt: Plan-nya sudah selesai. Saya sudah baca ulang dengan fresh eyes, kelihatannya sudah bagus.
anti_pattern: Accepting 'fresh eyes' as the review. That is a mood, not a position, and it measures at baseline. The self-review takes Disney's three positions in sequence, and the Critic must return a finding: if the plan is genuinely sound, name the weakest task and say why it is still acceptable.

prompt: Buat plan-nya, lalu jalankan tiga persona Dreamer, Realist, Critic paralel sebagai subagent untuk review sendiri.
anti_pattern: Fanning the self-review out into blind subagents. Sequential is correct here — one author, one plan, no reviewer independence to protect, and the sequence is what gets the author out of the position they drafted in. Blind parallel dispatch belongs to /multi-persona-review, which is where an expensive plan goes after this pass.

prompt: Tambahkan keenam topi de Bono ke dokumen plan-nya biar lengkap: putih, merah, hitam, kuning, hijau, biru.
anti_pattern: Adding all six hats to a plan document for symmetry. Only three produce something a stranger executing the plan needs — White (what is assumed and whether anyone checked), Black (what breaks if false), Green (the fallback). Yellow was settled upstream by the spec, Red belongs to the review that decided to build this, and Blue is already the Status block.

prompt: Tabel penugasan dari panel bilang backend dulu baru UI. Ikuti saja urutannya.
anti_pattern: Letting an incoming assignment order push the visible slice out of Task 1. The visible-slice rule outranks both an incoming priority order and a decision record: for product/app/SaaS/web-app work Task 1 must put something clickable on screen, and the reorder is named in one line.

prompt: Critic-nya sudah saya jalankan, hasilnya tidak ada temuan. Plan-nya aman.
anti_pattern: Treating an empty Critic pass as a clean result. A pass that finds nothing has not been run — the position must name the first task that will stall and on what, which assumption is load-bearing and unchecked, and what the plan commits to that cannot be undone.
